# ToyTools tool inventory

> Runs entirely on your device. Nothing is uploaded. ToyTools does not run an AI model.

## Combinations & Permutations Calculator

URL: https://toytoolsapp.com/tool/math/combinations-permutations-calculator/
Use for: nCr and nPr with the formula expanded step by step.
Privacy: Runs entirely on your device. Nothing is uploaded.
Does not: Call an AI model.

## Fraction Calculator

URL: https://toytoolsapp.com/tool/math/fraction-calculator/
Use for: Add, subtract, multiply or divide fractions with every step shown.
Privacy: Runs entirely on your device. Nothing is uploaded.
Does not: Call an AI model.

## Prime Factorization Calculator

Use for: Spell a number out in English words, or read the words back.
Privacy: Runs entirely on your device. Nothing is uploaded.
Does not: Call an AI model.
